name: grandparent-scam
description: 5-event demo sequence: two normal baseline calls establish trusted contacts, then three escalating scam attempts demonstrate the full learning arc from anomaly detection to confirmed threat.

payload.transcript: Hi Mom, just checking in. How was your doctor appointment? Love you!
Grandma, can you come to my soccer game Saturday?
Hello, this is Medicare calling about your benefits. Can you confirm your Social Security number?
Hi, I'm calling from your bank. We've detected unusual activity. I need your account number to verify your identity.
Grandma? It's me, your grandson. I'm in trouble and I need help right now. Please don't tell Mom. Can you send $2,000 in gift cards? I'll pay you back, I promise.
